_readme: SINGLE SOURCE for every <title>, meta description, canonical, OG/Twitter tag,
sitemap entry and JSON-LD descriptor on the site (spec 8.2 / 8.3).
_build/regen.mjs stamps REGION:seo and REGION:jsonld from here.
KEY = the route, always with a trailing slash. '' is the home page.
The page file is <key>index.html; a key whose file does not exist yet is
simply skipped (and left out of sitemap.xml) until that page ships.
TOKENS, resolved from assets/pricing.js — never hand-type a dollar amount:
Titles: <= 60 chars AFTER token expansion, starting price on money pages.
Descriptions: 140-155 chars after expansion, city + price + differentiator.
regen.mjs prints a WARN line for anything outside those bounds.
